name: LNDb challenge
description: A community challenge evaluating automated methods for lung cancer patient management from thoracic imaging (nodule detection/assessment and management decisions).
evaluation_method: Sensitivity at predefined false-positive rates (FROC) for detection and Dice/IoU for segmentation; accuracy for management decisions
general_score_metric: sensitivity (FROC) for detection; Dice coefficient for segmentation
typical_sota_score: detection sensitivity ~70–95% (depending on FP rate threshold); segmentation Dice ≈ 0.7–0.9 for top methods
reputation: Moderately used in medical imaging research for thoracic nodule tasks and cited alongside other public lung CT benchmarks, though less ubiquitous than some larger challenges.
notes: Limited dataset size and variability in CT protocols; annotation consistency and clinical applicability can vary; results sensitive to pre/post-processing and thresholding; privacy/clinical validation considerations.
